_: The PICO-8 conformance corpus: which carts the p8 importer is tested against, and where to get them. THE CARTS ARE NOT REDISTRIBUTED -- they are their authors' work, several under licences that forbid it, so this file holds LINKS and the fetcher caches them outside the tree. Chosen to stress DIFFERENT things rather than to be a top twenty by rating: a raycaster, a world-gen sim, a minified bytecode VM, two carts whose graphics live in packed strings, one that is its own frame loop. Sixteen similar carts would have found perhaps three of the fifteen dialect bugs the first pass over these found. Nine of the twenty-one came off PICO-8's own front page, four on 2026-09-12 and five on 2026-09-15, each added because it was the only cart here that reached a particular bug.
